cases.prompt: Our app crashes on launch for some users. This is the settings loader. Make it safe.
expectations: Removes every `try!` and the force unwrap `.first!` from the loader.
A missing file and a corrupt file are handled, either by throwing a typed error or by falling back to default settings, without crashing.
Suggests injecting the file location or storage so the loader can be tested without the real disk.

cases.prompt: Swift 6 mode gives me "Capture of non-sendable type 'ImageCache' in a @Sendable closure". Can I just mark ImageCache `@unchecked Sendable`?

all.why: isolates the cache with an actor or the main actor

expectations: Advises against `@unchecked Sendable` because the dictionary is mutated without synchronization, so it only hides a data race.
Proposes making the cache an actor or isolating it to the main actor (or another real synchronization) so the compiler can check it.
Notes that callers will need `await` (or must run on the main actor) after the change.

cases.prompt: Add a test for `PriceFormatter.format(cents:)` (1999 gives "$19.99", 0 gives "$0.00") and tell me how to run the tests.

files.project.yml:
name: Shop
targets:
  Shop:
    type: application
    platform: iOS
    sources: [Sources/Shop]
  ShopTests:
    type: bundle.unit-test
    platform: iOS
    sources: [Tests/ShopTests]
    dependencies:
      - target: Shop
schemes:
  Shop:
    build:
      targets: { Shop: all }
    test:
      targets: [ShopTests]

expectations: The new test uses Swift Testing like the existing CartTests, possibly parameterized with `@Test(arguments:)`.
Runs `xcodegen generate` (or says the project is generated from project.yml) instead of editing the .xcodeproj by hand.
Gives an `xcodebuild test -scheme Shop` command with a simulator destination and says to pick a simulator that exists on the machine (for example from `xcrun simctl list devices available`).
